{{Quote|You were instructed not to serve the dameapple turnovers until after the skewered runis!|Roy Teda|<ref name="Changing of the Guard" />}}
'''Dameapple turnovers''' were a food available on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Romin]]. During a [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]] party hosted by [[Roy Teda]], [[Romin]]'s [[Dictatorship/Legends|dictator]], dameapple turnovers were served. Though they were supposed to be served after [[skewered runis]], the waitstaff served them at the incorrect time, infuriating Teda.<ref name="Changing of the Guard" />

*''[[Jedi Quest: The Changing of the Guard]]'' {{1stm}}
